# webruntime_vocabulary.txt — the identifiers forge's GENERATED frontend code
# shares with @reliantlabs/forge-web-runtime's declarations: every token of a
# template (or Go-emitted golden) whose first line is "// Code generated by
# forge. DO NOT EDIT." that web-runtime/src (tests excluded) declares as an
# export, an interface/object member or a method.
#
# forge generate checks a frontend's installed runtime for each one its
# generated files use (WebRuntimeContentNotices). Never edit by hand:
#   UPDATE_WEBRUNTIME_VOCABULARY=1 go test -short -run TestWebRuntimeVocabularyIsCurrent ./internal/generator/
